items.html: Let us return to the matter: the measure of Aba and Ima, in all their aforementioned phases, which are Yisrael Saba and Tevuna, the whole measure of the length of their stature is from the throat of Arich Anpin to the midpoint of his Tifferet, of Arich Anpin himself. Therefore, they too did not need to gather their legs, like Atik and Arich Anpin, who are long of stature. However, when they clothed the NHY of Zeir Anpin, which clothe upon the HGT of Zeir Anpin himself:
